title: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA
seo_title: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA at Stone Chapel, Springfield
description: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA is a live concert featuring the music of Queen and ABBA, part of a series of multi-sensory musical experiences held in distinctive locations around Springfield. It takes place at Stone Chapel at Drury University, 900 N Benton Ave, Springfield, MO, on November 21, 2026, Time TBD.
